root_cause.text: Use of timer_delete() (non-blocking) instead of timer_delete_sync() for the wakeup_timer allows a concurrently running timer callback to access adapter fields after the adapter structure has been freed, causing a use-after-free.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states "timer_delete() does not wait for any running timer callback to complete. If the wakeup_timer callback... is executing... it will continue to access adapter fields... which may be freed... later." The patch changes `timer_delete` to `timer_delete_sync` in `mwifiex_adapter_cleanup()`.
